title: Reading — Six Words, Six Lines, and a First Passage
label: ch:ru-pervoe-chtenie
canDo: I can read Russian words off a board, read the lines I would say to a stranger, and hold a whole passage without translating it word by word.

payoff.summary: The introduction the book has been saying since chapter 2, read in order for the first time, with no new word in it.
